record_note: For the MB1367 NUCLEO-G474RE, UM2505 documents the 24 MHz X3 HSE crystal as the default source and an 8 MHz ST-LINK MCO as an alternative. Solder-bridge configuration must be recorded for a physical board before generation. Pin reservations and build/flash profiles remain open.
